baseDamageFormula: floor(floor(floor(attack * power * (2*level/5 + 2)) / defense) / 50) [+1 if 0], then STAB (*15/10 if attacker's type == move's type), then type-effectiveness multiplier (/10), then the random spread (85-100%, floor) - source: src/pokemon.c CalculateBaseDamage + src/battle_script_commands.c Cmd_typecalc/Cmd_adjustnormaldamage. Item/ability/weather/screen modifiers not included here (engine-logic scope, not pure data) - see CalculateBaseDamage directly for the full modifier chain.
